name: QwenPaw MMD Companion
description: Modern Three.js PMX/MMD desktop companion for QwenPaw, with avatar tools for PMX loading, VMD playback, expressions, mood, and gestures.

description_i18n.en-US: Modern Three.js PMX/MMD desktop companion for QwenPaw.

author: MMDdongbu

tools.name: avatar_load_model
tools.description: Load or replace the PMX model used by the MMD desktop companion.

tools.name: avatar_play_vmd
tools.description: Play a VMD motion on the current PMX model.

tools.name: avatar_perform_gesture
tools.description: Perform a semantic avatar gesture such as greet_user, thinking, nod, or idle.

tools.name: avatar_set_expression
tools.description: Set a PMX morph expression by name and weight.

tools.name: avatar_set_mood
tools.description: Set companion mood and idle energy.

tools.name: avatar_get_state
tools.description: Get current MMD companion bridge state.
